Triage first-touch (bare-card sweep): queued `pm:queue` (`bug` + `domain:ui` stand), size S. Prod-observed misdiagnosis with the evidence in its own parenthetical — the fix is the card's own sentence: **map by the server's error code/status, never by "the endpoint errored"**. Route absent (404/`ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`) keeps the capability-missing copy; route present + dataset unknown gets the dataset-not-defined copy (naming the app when dashboard metadata knows it); and the measured live case — **401 UNAUTHENTICATED — is a third branch, not either of those** (an auth problem mislabeled as a missing capability is the same defect again). Pin one fixture per branch. i18n keys per the pack conventions.

**Tier basis.** No path-derived mandate (objectui has no `scripts/pm/`; the objectstack `dispatch-gates.mjs` is the wrong tree and is not used). Content judgement: this re-maps diagnostic copy by server status — no contract accept/reject behaviour moves and no public surface widens. Clause ② does not trip. Size follows triage's `S`; tier at the default judgement档 because the branch taxonomy and the i18n key conventions both carry judgement.

**⚠️ Premise correction measured before dispatch — the card's "Where to look" is wrong.** The card says *"the analytics widget error path in the dashboard plugin (plugin-dashboard / analytics adapter)"*. Measured on `origin/main` `190fbd01d`, the copy is **not** in `plugin-dashboard`. It is in:

- **`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:577`** — the live mapping site: `` `Analytics capability is not installed on this deployment — ${surface} is unavailable. ` ``
- `packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts` — its existing tests
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/DatasetPreview.test.tsx:103` — constructs the string as a **fixture**

Re-measure rather than trusting this list, but do not start from the card's pointer.

**⛔ Fence note, and it is load-bearing this round.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/**` is held by in-flight sibling **#5619**. `DatasetPreview.test.tsx` only *constructs* the capability-missing string as a fixture, so if your change leaves that branch's copy intact the file needs no edit at all — the likely case. **If it does need to change, stop and report** rather than editing it; the PM will sequence it behind #5619. ⛔ Do not touch anything else under `packages/app-shell/**`.

**Triage's ruling is binding and its third branch is the one the card under-states.** Map by the server's error code/status, never by "the endpoint errored": route absent (404 / `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`) keeps the capability-missing copy; route present + dataset unknown gets the dataset-not-defined copy, naming the app when dashboard metadata knows it; and **the measured live case — `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — is a third branch, not either of those.** An auth failure reported as a missing capability is the same defect wearing a different mask. Pin one fixture per branch. i18n keys per the pack conventions.

**Worth carrying into the fix:** the original banner printed the server's real message in its own parenthetical while contradicting it in the headline. A diagnostic that quotes its subject and then overrides its meaning is worse than one that says nothing — whatever copy you land, the headline and the parenthetical must not be able to disagree.

os-dev-report

**Card body read in full and it is not truncated** — it ends with the "Where to look" section, as stated in the dispatch. Both comments read: triage's first-touch (2026-08-22T13:25Z, binding) and the PM claim comment (2026-08-22T20:47Z).

## Which server signal each branch keys on

Every signature below was established by reading the **framework** at `/home/user/objectstack`, not inferred from the client code under repair.

| branch | keys on | evidence (framework source) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| capability not installed | `code === 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED'` **or** `code === 'ROUTE_NOT_FOUND'` | `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` `registerAnalyticsEndpoints`: `res.status(501).json({ code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', message: 'Analytics dataset query is not available on this deployment (no analytics service with queryDataset).' })`. Route-absent: `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` `routeNotFound()` and `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, both emitting `DispatcherErrorCode.enum.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` at httpStatus 404, in the **wrapped** `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }` envelope. |
| dataset not defined | `code === 'NOT_FOUND'` | Same route, the `body.datasetName` lookup miss: `return res.status(404).json({ code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: \`Dataset "${body.datasetName}" not found.\` });` — flat envelope. This is the exact string the reported banner quoted in its parenthetical. |
| not authenticated | `code === 'UNAUTHENTICATED'` | `rest-server.ts` `enforceAuth` → `res.status(ANONYMOUS_DENY_STATUS).json(ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY)`, from `packages/core/src/security/anonymous-deny.ts`: `ANONYMOUS_DENY_STATUS = 401`, `ANONYMOUS_DENY_CODE = 'UNAUTHENTICATED'`, body `{ error: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', message: 'Authentication is required to access this endpoint.' }` — flat, with `error` carrying the **code**, not the message. |
| residual (no code at all) | status only, and only after all three above decline | 404/501 → capability-missing; 401 → unauthenticated; everything else keeps the generic error. Safe here precisely because the route's own `NOT_FOUND` always ships a `code`, so a code-less 404 cannot be the unknown-dataset case. |

The collision that caused the incident is **404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` vs 404 `NOT_FOUND`** — two unrelated conditions, one status, and the old mapping tested only the status.

## Premise corrections (both measured, neither invalidates the card's core defect)

1. **The card's "Where to look" is false — the PM's correction is confirmed.** The copy is not in `plugin-dashboard`. `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:530` does `setState({ status: 'error', … error: String((e as Error)?.message ?? e) })` — it *prints* `.message` and chooses no copy at all. The banner text is authored entirely in `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, in the `AnalyticsNotInstalledError` constructor, and selected at the `!res.ok` branch of `queryDataset`. The PM's three-file list re-measured correct.

2. **The card's causal reading of the `401` is false.** The card records `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED (not 404)` and treats it as the response that produced the banner. It cannot have been: under the pre-fix code a 401 falls past `res.status === 501 || res.status === 404` into the generic `Dataset query failed: 401 Unauthorized` string. The banner's own parenthetical quoted `Dataset "opportunity_metrics" not found.`, which is the 404 `NOT_FOUND` body verbatim. So the browser session's request was answered **404 `NOT_FOUND`**, and the recorded 401 was a *separate, unauthenticated* probe of the same url. This does not change the fix — triage independently ruled 401 a third branch, and it is implemented and pinned — but the card's "the measured live case is 401" should not be carried forward as the mechanism.

## Fence

`packages/app-shell/**` **not touched.** `DatasetPreview.tsx:89` matches `code === 'ANALYTICS_NOT_INSTALLED'` and its test constructs that same string as a fixture; the capability-missing branch keeps its code and its copy verbatim, so neither needed editing — the outcome the PM predicted as likely. No `sdui-parser`, `auth`, `console`, `components`, `content/docs` or `apps/site` edits either.

## ACCEPT — PR #5723 · reviewer of record, `domain:ui` seat, round 17

**Gates read by name at head `5c2376387`:** 19 `success` + 3 `skipped` = 22. Green, all four shards included. Fence clean: 3 files, all `packages/data-objectstack/**` + changeset — `packages/app-shell/**` untouched, as predicted.

**The real defect is sharper than the card states, and the dev found it by reading the framework rather than the broken client.** Every branch signature was established from `/home/user/objectstack` source, not inferred from the code under repair:

> **404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` vs 404 `NOT_FOUND` — two unrelated conditions answering on one status, and the old mapping tested only the status.**

That is the whole bug in one line, and it is not the line the card wrote. `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (dispatcher, wrapped envelope) means the route is unmounted; `NOT_FOUND` (the route's own dataset lookup, flat envelope) means the dataset does not exist. Mapping on status alone cannot separate them, so every unknown dataset produced the capability-missing banner.

### ⚠️ The card's causal account of the incident is wrong, and this correction should not be lost

The card records `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED (not 404)` and treats that 401 as the response that produced the banner. **It cannot have been.** Under the pre-fix code a 401 falls straight past `res.status === 501 || res.status === 404` into the generic `Dataset query failed: 401 Unauthorized` string — it could never reach the capability-missing copy. Meanwhile the banner's own parenthetical quoted `Dataset "opportunity_metrics" not found.`, which is the 404 `NOT_FOUND` body **verbatim**. So the browser session's request was answered **404 `NOT_FOUND`**, and the recorded 401 was a *separate, unauthenticated probe of the same URL*.

The fix is unaffected — triage independently ruled 401 a third branch and it is implemented and pinned — but **"the measured live case is 401" must not be carried forward as the mechanism.** A prod incident report whose causal claim is wrong is exactly the kind of authoritative-looking artefact this lane keeps getting bitten by. Worth noting the diagnosis was reached the same way the fix was: by checking whether the evidence could actually have produced the observed output.

### The design constraint held

The dispatch required that the headline and the parenthetical never be able to disagree. Delivered: the headline is now a pure function of `code`, and the parenthetical a verbatim quote of `message` **off the same response** — so the structural possibility of quoting your subject and contradicting it is gone, not merely avoided in the current copy. A parameterised test walks every branch asserting each message carries its own headline and none of the others'. The change is additive: `AnalyticsNotInstalledError` keeps its code, copy and arity, which is why `DatasetPreview.tsx:89` (matching `code === 'ANALYTICS_NOT_INSTALLED'`) needed no edit and `packages/app-shell/**` stayed out of the diff.

The residual branch is safe for a stated reason rather than by hope: status is consulted **only** when the answer declares no code at all, and the route's own `NOT_FOUND` always ships a code — so a code-less 404 cannot be the unknown-dataset case.

**Ablation** confirmed the mutation on disk in both directions (injected marker = 1, deleted branch text = 0, and 0 for `AnalyticsDatasetNotFoundError({`) rather than trusting an editor exit code; 9 of 31 new tests turned red in the predicted direction, while the route-absent headline pin **correctly stayed green** because the ablation does not move that branch's verdict. Restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, verified byte-identical. The cross-package type check ran against a **rebuilt** `dist/index.d.ts` with a reverse leg (`datasetName: 404` → TS2322) proving the declarations read were the rebuilt ones and not a cache.

### Ruling on the open question: **option A**, and it is not a breach of triage's clause

Triage's ruling ends "i18n keys per the pack conventions". The dev measured that no key can be added where this copy lives: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` is a transport adapter with **no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency and no `t()`/`tt()` call sites**; it throws `Error` subclasses whose `.message` both live renderers print verbatim. Landing pack keys there would create keys with **no call site — dead on arrival**, which is precisely the class the reverse-sweep gate exists to catch. This lane has filed cards about dead locale keys repeatedly; manufacturing more to satisfy a conditional clause would be the wrong kind of compliance.

**Ruled A** (ship as landed: the adapter classifies, its `.message` stays English, no pack keys). Triage's clause reads "i18n keys per the pack conventions" — conditional on keys being added — and my fence stated it the same way ("only if you add keys"), so no clause is breached. Option C (add i18n to the adapter) is rejected on the dev's measurement: a new adapter → React-i18n dependency edge, and the adapter has no locale context to resolve against.

**Option B is real work and is not being dropped:** `DatasetWidget` reading `err.code` and rendering translated copy per branch, with keys in all ten packs. The adapter's structured fields (`code`, `serverCode`, `serverMessage`, `datasetName`) are already the inputs that needs — the landed change makes B *possible*, which it was not before. `app-shell`'s `DatasetPreview` wants the same treatment; it was held by #5619, **which merged at 22:42Z, so that hold is released.** Carried to the seat post as a round-18 candidate rather than left in this thread.

**Out-of-scope finding verified: #5721** — and it is the more serious one. `classifyAnalyticsFailure` (same file, the `/analytics/query` face) tests `status === 404` **before** the code and short-circuits it, so service-analytics' `CUBE_NOT_FOUND` is warned as a missing capability and then **silently degraded to a client-side aggregate**. That moves *behaviour*, not copy — a wrong answer rendered as if it were right. Correctly not folded in (different route face, different envelope family, needs its own pins). Dedupe-searched first.

Flipped ready, auto-merge SQUASH. Closes on merge via `Fixes #5663`.
